key_insight: QEDIA shows that quantum programs mixing classical and quantum control can be formally verified in Lean 4 by mechanizing both the quantum Hoare logic and its soundness end-to-end.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical path toward trustworthy quantum software by enabling machine-checked proofs for real quantum algorithms with classical variables and measurement-driven control flow.
method: Formalize quantum mechanics, program syntax/semantics, specifications, and proof rules in Lean 4.
Implement the open QHL+ library and prove soundness for both partial and total correctness.
Use an LLM-based prover agent, under human supervision, to build the library and verify example programs.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports verified case studies including quantum Fourier transform, phase estimation, repeat-until-success circuits, and Hamiltonian simulation.
watch_item: The workflow still relies on human supervision and an extended prover agent, so scalability and robustness on larger quantum developments remain a concern.
paper_title: QEDIA: Quantum Program Verification in Lean
